name: Singing (Weapon Quality)
body:
Price +1 bonus; Slot weapon quality; CL 10th; Weight —; Aura moderate evocation

DESCRIPTION

Upon command, a singing weapon vibrates and resonates with crystalline tones that deal an extra 1d6 points of sonic damage on a successful hit. The wielder is not harmed by this effect.

The effect remains until another command is given.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor; Spells shout, sonic scream, or sound burst
